instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/base_ref.step in BRL-CAD. Generate only a matching cover plate: outer size 124 x 84 x 6 mm, centered on the base_ref bounding box so it overhangs evenly by 12 mm in X and Y; four mounting holes are coaxial with the four base holes, each with diameter 6.5 mm; the cover bottom face is 2 mm above the base top face. Generate only the cover geometry; do not include the base body in the output. Save the completed STL mesh as /home/user/Desktop/out.stl. [Software] Run `mged` from a terminal (use the full path if it is not on PATH).
